userStories.title: AutoCompactEngine robustness — prefix protection + hysteresis + focus topic wiring
userStories.description: Phase-CTX shipped the AutoCompactEngine but 3 robustness gaps remain. (1) PREFIX PROTECTION: Codex-style two-scope split must treat messages[0] (system role) + any contiguous leading system-overlay messages as the untouchable prefix; only the 'body' (everything after the last system message) gets compacted. Without this, compaction regresses SOUL.md/AGENT.md/TOOLS.md/USER.md and the agent forgets instructions. (2) HYSTERESIS: after a compaction lands, ShouldCompress must return false until N>=3 turns pass (env AURA_MIN_TURNS_BETWEEN_COMPACTIONS default 3). Without this, a heavy tool result that re-grows the window above 50% one turn after compaction triggers a re-compact every turn = catastrophic latency (hermes-agent compresses_per_session counter exists for exactly this reason). (3) FOCUS TOPIC: ContextCompressor.Compress takes focusTopic but US-CTX-05 wiring may not have populated it. Agent loop must extract last user-message text (truncate to 500 chars max) and pass as focusTopic. Without it, summaries are generic = lower quality retention. All 3 are unit-testable AND must be live-validated by triggering compaction in a real probe_chat session.
acceptanceCriteria: internal/conversation/auto_compact.go (or compressor.go depending on US-CTX-04 final placement): new function splitPrefixAndBody(messages) returns (prefix []Message, body []Message) where prefix = all leading messages with Role=='system' (contiguous from index 0), body = remainder. Compress only operates on body; prefix is concatenated back unchanged.

internal/conversation/auto_compact.go: AutoCompactEngine.LastCompactionTurnIndex int field added; ShouldCompress returns false if currentTurnIndex - LastCompactionTurnIndex < MinTurnsBetweenCompactions (cfg field, env AURA_MIN_TURNS_BETWEEN_COMPACTIONS default 3); UpdateFromResponse stores currentTurnIndex via new parameter or via tracking inside the engine

internal/agent/loop.go or internal/chat/agentloop.go: before calling engine.Compress, extract focusTopic from messages by walking backwards to find last Role=='user' message, truncate Content to 500 chars (rune-safe), pass as 3rd arg to Compress

internal/conversation/auto_compact_test.go: new tests — TestPrefixProtectionKeepsSystemMessages (3 system messages prepended + 50 body messages; compact returns all 3 system intact + summarized body), TestHysteresisBlocksRepeatedCompaction (3 consecutive ShouldCompress checks: first true, second/third false), TestFocusTopicExtractionFromLastUserMessage (10 messages mixed user/assistant, extract returns last user text truncated to 500)
Live test step 1 — container rebuild: docker compose build aura --no-cache  (must succeed without error)

Live test step 2 — probe_chat 20-turn synthetic conversation script that injects a heavy tool result mid-conversation forcing >50% threshold; capture /api/metrics output before/after — assertion: aura_compaction_count metric == 1 (NOT >1, proving hysteresis works); aura_compaction_prefix_preserved_count == 1 (proving prefix not touched)

Live test step 3 — DB ground-truth: SELECT count(*) FROM conversations WHERE compaction_event IS NOT NULL (or equivalent table introduced by US-CTX-05 metrics) returns exactly 1 row for the probe conversation
Live test step 4 — log inspection: grep '\[compaction\]' docker compose logs aura  shows structured line with focus_topic_chars=<N> field where N > 0 (proves focusTopic threaded through)

userStories.title: Bench fixture + threshold tuning per model + quality snapshot update
userStories.description: Phase-CTX shipped the compaction substrate but there's ZERO live evidence it actually works on real workloads. Build a benchmark harness with 4 representative conversation fixtures, run them against the 3 active OpenRouter models (deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash=163840 ctx, google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it=131072 ctx, anthropic/claude-sonnet-4=200000 ctx), collect token-savings + latency + quality numbers, populate docs/aura-quality-snapshot.md with the table. Per feedback_aura_as_product memory: 'quality matrix obbligatorio' — every wave gates on numbers. Per CLAUDE.md 'TESTS VERIFY QUALITY AND METRICS, NOT JUST DID IT RUN' rule, bench must measure both token-savings AND reply-quality keyword retention, not just 'compaction ran'. The 50% threshold may be sub-optimal for some models — bench data informs whether to keep or tune per-model.
acceptanceCriteria: internal/conversation/testdata/bench/ (NEW dir) contains 4 fixture JSON files: short_qa.json (10 turns, no tool results), tool_heavy_research.json (30 turns + 5 tool results 8000 chars each), multimodal_visual.json (10 turns + 8 image_url messages), long_session.json (100 turns mixed)

cmd/bench_ctx/main.go (NEW) loads each fixture, computes input tokens via existing tokenjuice/budget package, runs Compressor.Compress with focusTopic = last user msg, measures pre/post tokens + compaction wall-clock, runs 1 follow-up LLM call comparing reply quality (does reply contain expected keyword from fixture metadata)

cmd/bench_ctx outputs JSON to .planning/post-drift-2026-05-21/Phase-CTX/bench-results-<YYYY-MM-DD>.json with structure: {model: <id>, fixture: <name>, pre_tokens, post_tokens, savings_pct, latency_ms, quality_keyword_retained: bool}
Bench runs for all 3 models in CI-friendly mode (uses AURA_LLM_API_KEY env, skips with t.Skip if unset)
docs/aura-quality-snapshot.md NEW section '### Phase-CTX Compaction Benchmark (2026-MM-DD)' with markdown table: rows=fixtures, cols=models, cells=savings_pct/latency_ms/quality_pass
AT LEAST ONE fixture×model combo MUST show >40% token reduction with quality_keyword_retained=true — this is the GO/NO-GO signal that compaction earns its keep

Threshold recommendation: bench JSON includes 'recommended_threshold_pct' field per model; if any model recommends != 50% (e.g., 45% or 55%), commit body lists it as follow-up tuning candidate (no code change in this story — just data)
Live test step 1 — container rebuild required: docker compose build aura  (must succeed)

Live test step 2 — run cmd/bench_ctx in container against live OpenRouter (export OPENROUTER_KEY in env from existing .env) — bench MUST emit the JSON file and at least one model×fixture passes the 40%+savings + keyword-retained gate
go test ./cmd/bench_ctx/... -count=1 green (unit tests for fixture parser + table renderer)
golangci-lint clean on touched files; new code ≤500 LOC across cmd/bench_ctx + new helpers
Single atomic commit prefix: feat(bench): Phase-CTX compaction bench + quality snapshot update (US-CTX-07)
userStories.notes: Without this story Phase-CTX is committed but UNVALIDATED. 50% threshold is plausibly right for Claude (200k ctx) but possibly wrong for Gemma (131k) where 50% = 65k still leaves plenty of room. Bench produces the data to decide; tuning itself can be a 1-line config change in a future story. The 40% savings gate is the existence test — if NO model×fixture clears it, the compaction work earned nothing in production and we should rethink.

userStories.title: Structured compaction event log + /api/conversations/:id/compactions endpoint
userStories.description: US-CTX-05 added /api/metrics counters but they're aggregate-only. For debugging 'why did Aura forget X' or 'why did this turn take 8s', we need per-event structured logging + per-conversation history. Add CompactionEvent record persisted to SQLite per compaction (conv_id, turn_index, pre_tokens, post_tokens, layer breakdown {tokenjuice_savings, summarizer_savings, autocompact_savings}, latency_ms, focus_topic_preview, timestamp), zap structured log line emitted with same shape, and a new GET /api/conversations/:id/compactions endpoint returning event array. This is OPTIONAL for Phase-CTX correctness (CTX-06 + CTX-07 already make it correct + validated) but mandatory for production debuggability per CLAUDE.md 'NEVER BE SUPERFICIAL — INSPECT THE ACTUAL ARTIFACT' rule applied to compaction debugging.
acceptanceCriteria: internal/db/migrations/NNN_compaction_events.sql (NEW): CREATE TABLE compaction_events (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL, turn_index INT NOT NULL, pre_tokens INT, post_tokens INT, tokenjuice_savings INT, summarizer_savings INT, autocompact_savings INT, latency_ms INT, focus_topic_preview TEXT, created_at INTEGER); index on (conversation_id, turn_index)

internal/conversation/event_log.go (NEW): CompactionEvent struct mirroring table columns + RecordCompaction(ctx, db, event) function; called by ContextCompressor + AutoCompactEngine + payload_summarizer (each layer fills its own savings field, others = 0)
